rationale: This solution implements a deadline-priority greedy algorithm that assigns claims based on the earliest deadline first (EDD) heuristic. The approach prioritizes cases with earlier deadlines to minimize missed deadlines, which aligns with the R1 requirement. Key features include: 1) Reading input from input.json and writing output to output.json, 2) Sorting cases by deadline day to prioritize urgent cases, 3) Checking skill matching between reviewers and cases, 4) Verifying daily capacity constraints for each reviewer, 5) Assigning cases to the earliest available day that meets all requirements, 6) Handling unassigned cases by adding them to the unassigned_case_ids list. The solution avoids overtime, ensures one assignment per case, respects skill requirements, and maintains the same duration as specified in the input data.
